answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 15 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 780 identities costs 780 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. A ridge of doubt is healthy, a quill of proof is required, and a fable of patience is the price of a clean panel.
